answers.QID18: The biggest hurdle to trying to navigate the robot through the warehouse was the strange layout of the actual warehouse. I did not see a need to use the loops often enough because there was not a pattern like structure to the warehouse to where I could modularize the robots movements or chunk it into different patterns.
answers.QID19: None of the blocks were hard to grasp but some were not very well explained in some sense; the need to sense ahead was only very useful for keeping track of obstacles that would end the run and not be very useful for navigating the warehouse without a large decision tree.
answers.QID23: I would change how quickly you could place certain blocks down so that it would be easier to iterate through certain movements.
